ordering_criterion_change.note: Before the freeze, the author read the count of each pass@1 value, as disclosure 2 says. Nobody computed a score, interval, or decision of a public model. The owner confirmed this disclosure with this note on 23 November 2026.
ordering_criterion_change.policy_text: The ordering criterion of the pruned-set test changed after the author saw the 3-model results. The criterion now applies only to model pairs with a full-set gap of 0.10 or more. The author fixed this change before anyone read a public grade.

public_panel_read.note: The public loader (#75) parsed and range-checked every pass@1 value in memory before the freeze. Only model names and question metadata came out of the loader. The owner confirmed this disclosure with this note on 23 November 2026.
public_panel_read.policy_text: Before this freeze, the author read these facts from the public panel: the file shape, the model names, and the count of each pass@1 value. The author also read the question dates, difficulty labels, and platforms, and the release_date field. Nobody computed a score or a decision of a public model.

reference_replay_seen.note: In this text, "the author" means the repository owner and the AI agents that worked for the owner. A session record of 29 October 2026 shows that an agent made a script for a scratch threshold replay. The script no longer exists, so this report cannot check what it read. The owner did not confirm this disclosure from memory.
reference_replay_seen.policy_text: The author saw a scratch replay on the 3 reference models before this freeze. The rules choose every tuned value from simulated results only. This choice reduces the bias from that replay, but it does not remove it. The simulated models start from the grades of the same 3 reference models.
